title: Serum Biochemical Indexes Detection
author: Honghao Zhao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.smeec3e

steps.title: Collect Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 180 - 200 mL of blood per tail from 10 Ctenopharyngodon idellus per group via caudal vein injector puncture without using an anti-coagulating substance.

steps.title: Separate Serum
steps.instruction: Process the blood samples to isolate serum through clotting and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Place blood samples at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 3000 g for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Store Serum
steps.instruction: Store the separated serum at -80 ℃ until biochemical index detection and analysis.

steps.title: Measure Biochemical Indexes
steps.instruction: Measure lactate dehydrogenase, glutamic-oxalacetic tansaminase, glutamic-pyruvic transaminase, alkaline phosphatase, total cholesterol, high density cholesterol, glucose, albumin, total protein, and triglycerides using an automatic biochemistry analyzer (Hitachi 7020, Hitachi High Technologies, Inc., Ibaraki, Japan).

substeps.instruction: Use test kits (standard samples of serum biochemical indexes) purchased from the Nanjing Jiancheng Biochemical Corporation (Nanjing Jiancheng Biochemical Corporation, Nanjing, China).
Perform the entire procedure in accordance with the kit instructions.
